summary: Describes how RSVP PathErr messages can trigger rerouting of point-to-point MPLS and GMPLS traffic engineering label switched paths without first tearing down the path state or its resources. This enables smoother reroutes. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: When a road needs to be moved, you can send a note asking drivers to switch to a new route without closing the old road first. This document describes that note for network paths.

questions: how to reroute an mpls lsp with a patherr message
